title: EU regime | EU departure (Spain) | Delay 4h+ (5h) | MANUAL: No Determination for one reason only (carrier at fault unknown) | Travelled (arrived late) | 2 Pax | Single leg | Residence: Spain
description:
Checks that DDS sends an EU claim to manual review when the only problem is that it can't identify the operating carrier. Flight AC 837 Madrid (MAD) ? Toronto (YYZ) is sold as AC and arrives 5 hours late. It's the only leg, so it's the MSL. Trip Tracer has no operating carrier recorded, so DDS can't match it to AC or an AC family carrier, STAR or OAL. Everything else passes: EU applies (Spain departure), APPR also applies (Canada arrival), the Spain 5-year limit is met, the delay is 300 minutes, and a controllable arrival code (96) is logged. Because of the carrier, DDS returns NO DETERMINATION for both passengers with EUR 0. It doesn't return Eligible (EUR 600) or Not Eligible. The chatbot shows the standard No Determination message and creates one case for both passengers, sent to manual review with a 30-day commitment. No CyberSource check, Cash or AC Wallet offer, IDV or payment details. BSM email and phone are not collected.
